name: team-management
description: TeamFlow — Role-based Task & Project Management System

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run build:frontend
